title: Hazel and the Cipher
author: Casper Vane
blurb: Dominic Pemberton, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent ten years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the trial begins.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
